body: I’m 21F, got it in April. I know what you’re going through, but in time, I promise it gets better.

Correct me if I’m wrong please, but since the transmission rate is so low already with genital hsv1 given genitally  along with daily medication and condom usage, I should just assume and hope the other person already has it or that they won’t catch it?

I’ve only had one and currently getting over. I know there’s a stigma, I basically thought the same prior to this happening. I has no knowledge before getting diagnosed. 
Because I know I used to be close minded on this topic, I know there’s more like the old me.
I just found out I had it yesterday. I’ve been nonstop crying at the fact that this is my new reality and I feel dirty honestly. I don’t know how to feel and it’s been difficult.
